title: InceptionMountStrategy — Podman mount-type contract per execution context
description: Maps each agent-execution context to the right Podman mount type (named volume | bind | tmpfs), following Docker's Manage-data three-mount model applied to the sovereign Podman runtime. STRUCTURAL teeth live here (enum coherence, required scope_ref, bind requires source, context->mount-type mapping, task-persistence lock). The SEMANTIC teeth that need the real filesystem (a bind whose source resolves through a symlink) and the scope-namespace coherence (cross-scope leakage) live in tools/verify_mount_strategy.py, which validates against this schema first, then resolves the host path. Podman is the sovereign runtime — not Docker.

context.$comment: The agent-execution context this mount serves. Determines the only admissible mount type.

mount_type.$comment: Podman mount type. volume = sovereign-managed, durable, NOT host-coupled. bind = a scoped host path. tmpfs = memory-only, ephemeral.

scope_ref.$comment: Which chat/workspace/project/dir/task/user this mount is bound to. REQUIRED and non-empty so cross-scope leakage is unrepresentable. Namespace must match the context (verifier enforces prefix, e.g. chat: -> chat).

durability.$comment: Whether the data outlives the container. durable => must be a named volume. ephemeral => must be tmpfs.

symlink_safe.$comment: Claim that the mount source does not resolve through a symlink. For a bind this MUST be true, and the verifier PROVES it against the real filesystem (never trust the claim: feedback_never_write_through_symlink).

source.$comment: Host path for a bind mount. Required only for mount_type=bind. Ignored for volume (name is derived from scope_ref) and tmpfs (no source).

declared_durable.$comment: Explicit override for task_execution ONLY: a task context is ephemeral tmpfs by default; set true to justify a durable volume/bind for a task. Absent or false => the task-persistence lock applies.

allOf.$comment: COHERENCE: a named volume is always durable.
TEETH: a bind must name a source and must claim symlink_safe (the verifier then proves it on the real FS).
TEETH: the directory context is a scoped bind of a host directory / project source.
TEETH: durable-state contexts (userspace/chat/workspace/project) MUST be named volumes. tmpfs => data loss; bind => host-coupled durable state. Both REJECTED.
TEETH: task-persistence lock. A task_execution context is tmpfs+ephemeral UNLESS declared_durable is explicitly true. A task on a durable volume/bind without that declaration is REJECTED.
